## Today's learning {#iv4-objective .vector-lesson .magnitude-lesson }

### Learning objective

Use vector components to calculate lengths, midpoints, unit vectors and scalar products in two and three dimensions.

### Success criterion

I can solve these problems and identify whether my answer is a point, a vector or a scalar.

::: takeaway
Familiar geometry gives the insight; vectors give us a general method.
:::
